entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure applicable only to a UE configured for eCall only mode. It is triggered by timer expirations and results in detach procedures and state transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer related to eCall inactivity procedure. Expiration triggers the procedure when T3445 is not running.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer related to eCall inactivity procedure. Expiration triggers the procedure when T3444 is not running.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE must be (except PLMN-SEARCH or NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substates) for eCall inactivity procedure to start.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM mode where the UE must be for eCall inactivity procedure to start.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered after completing the eCall inactivity procedure actions.

entities.name: Delete stored information
entities.description: Action to delete GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, and eKSI.

entities.name: Timer expiry condition
entities.description: Condition where T3444 expires and T3445 not running, or T3445 expires and T3444 not running, or both timers expire.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state (except specific substates).
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE mode.
Timer expiry condition triggers the eCall inactivity procedure.
Procedure results in deletion of stored information.
Procedure results in transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state.
